title: 1625 Prairie's windows as its 1890 photograph shows them
items: McBirney's house at 1625 Prairie now has the photograph's windows, each where the print puts it: two-light casements on stone mullions, transomed on the first floor, a wide four-light window over the door, and segment-headed sash above.
The basement lights the old front carried are gone; the photograph shows a plain plinth.
Still to come for this house: its proud, quoined entrance bay with the carved panel, and the four-storey rear.
